title: Generator Fuel Management, Maintenance Schedule & Total Cost of Ownership Pakistan 2026 — DG Set Diesel Quality, Oil Change Intervals, NEPRA Fuel Compliance & 10-Year TCO Analysis | Complete Buyer Guide
summary_html: Pakistan-specific generator fuel management guide 2026. 500ppm sulphur diesel demands 250-hour oil changes (not 500), fuel polishing every 500 hours, and NEPRA-certified flow meters for registered DG sets >100kVA. FIA/OGRA surveys show 38–52% retail diesel is adulterated — density meter testing on every delivery is essential. 10-year TCO analysis for Lahore vs Quetta, altitude derating 8-city table, PKR maintenance price tables, worked examples for 625kVA textile mill and 250kVA dairy factory. Seven common mistakes costing PKR 500k–5M+. Cluster completes: D110 DG Set Sizing → D111 AMF Panel → D112 Fuel Management & TCO.
